authority: #K2-438 sec.3.2: for the port/policy-class residuals, the FIRST action is the product-first three questions (sec.20). Answer all three BEFORE acting.
subject: the five residuals of the R1286 run: NRST (CONTROL), P3V3_AUX x2 + P3V3 (POWER), I2C1_SDA (BUS) - all one class: nets whose copper exists BOTH inside and outside dR, or POWER pads with no plane tie.

q1_same_class_finished_product.a_same_chip: TI DS320PR1601 (the K2 main device) - the vendor EVM layout (SNLS683 datasheet + SNLA425 programming guide). In-register as REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.A1, both machine-fetched HTTP 200 with local copies in /tmp/opencode/sup746_anchor/.
q1_same_class_finished_product.b_same_class: PCIe-switch / RD left-region 'power + control + bus' fanout on an 8-layer board with inner-1OZ power planes - REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.A (Lichuang PEX88096 dual-card open design) and sec.C (Opsero OP103 MCIO PCIe FMC, open datasheet incl. schematic).

q2_copyable_in_register: REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.A1 (1) DS320PR1601 datasheet SNLS683 - power/decap and layout notes.
REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.A1 (2) SNLA425 sec.1.1 - the vendor's RECOMMENDED grouped/channel fanout (the policy this class needs: group the fanout, run long segments straight, one layer change per group).
REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.A (1)(2)(12) PEX88096 datasheet + configured SBR + the machine-fetched attachment set - 8-layer stack with inner-1OZ power planes (the plane-stub practice).
REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.C Opsero OP103 - open schematic showing RD power/plane tie and sideband (i2c/perst) fanout.

in-repo: tools/eda_eng/block.py (frame selection + port semantics), exam A/B judge, regen.wipe_resolve_chain (the wipe->place->route skeleton), tools/k2_endpoint_reach_planner_v1.py (deterministic endpoint-reach lanes).
q3_difference_list: MISSING (a) PLANE TIE for POWER pads: C84.1 (P3V3) and C90.1 (P3V3_AUX) are SMD pads on F.Cu ONLY (drill 0, pad type SMD) and NO footprint carries a P3V3/P3V3_AUX pad on In4 - so the plane can only be reached by a VIA. The copyable practice: tie the pad to the inner-1OZ plane with a via, never a thin track.

MISSING (b) BOUNDARY PORT LANDING: NRST / I2C1_SDA / P3V3_AUX / P3V3 all have copper on BOTH sides of dR. The in-frame maze must land on a dR port that has an in-frame free start cell; the current chain clips to x=51.5 and leaves a 0.14mm dangling stub - the maze then reports no-free-start-node.
MISSING (c) THE FUNCTIONAL-BLOCK CHANNEL NEVER REACHES THE MAZE (see K2_CHANNEL_WIRING_DEFECT_RECEIPT_v1) - so this class was never actually run under the copied grouped-channel policy.
MISSING (d) ZONE COVERAGE: the in-frame P3V3 In4 finger stops at y~39.5, so C84.1 (y=44.0) sits outside its own plane. The copyable practice: extend the plane finger under the decap row.
verdict: questions answered; the copyable items EXIST and are in-register => acting by drawing (sec.16.3), not by search.
